PRIVACY & READER CHOICES

Your reading. Your choice.

Share this pageWhatsApp
XShare image

The public Pinnacle verification library can be read, searched and shared without accepting analytics.

Optional Google Analytics

Section link

With your permission, we use Google Analytics to understand visits and use of this public evidence library: topics opened, source links, document downloads, citation copying, language selection and sharing controls. These are interactions with public information, not clinical assessments.

The Google tag is loaded only after you choose “Allow analytics”. It uses analytics cookies and Google processes technical information such as device, browser and network information. Advertising storage, advertising user data and advertising personalisation are denied in this integration.

We send the canonical public page address without query strings, a generic page title, public reference identifiers and interaction categories. We do not send your search text, names, email address, phone number, assessment answers, AbilityScore or WhatsApp message contents. Automatic form, search and outbound-link measurement is disabled for this stream.

Your choice is remembered on this browser for up to 180 days. “Analytics choices” lets you change it. Declining or withdrawing stops future measurement on this verification page and clears its dedicated analytics cookies; it does not erase data already received by Google. A Global Privacy Control signal keeps analytics off.

Reading in another language

Section link

Translation is optional and opens Google Translate with the public page address. Google then provides the translated view under its own policies. Machine translation can change technical wording; original documents and citation identifiers remain the reference.
